description: Fetch the updates the owner posted on one place's listing, newest first: the text, the day, an image and where it links, such as an offer or an event. Use this to watch what a competitor announces. Give exactly one of `place_id` or `url`. Costs 4 credits, cached or not; a failed call is refunded.

cursor.description: The `meta.next_cursor` from the previous page. Omit for the first page.

fresh.description: Skip the cache and fetch now. Charged normally. Not available on trial credits — buy any pack to unlock it.

url.description: The full URL of the place on Google Maps, which carries its id. A short maps.app.goo.gl link does not, so open it and copy the address it leads to.

name: get_place_posts
title: Get an owner's posts on a Google Maps place
